newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Jan-August metals processing steadier.
newsitem.headline: German Jan-August metals processing steadier.

text.p: German metals processing in the first eight months of 1996 was down on the same 1995 period, but year-on-year decreases were slowing, according to official data published on Monday.
Losses in semi-finished metals output over last year narrowed in Jan-August compared with Jan-July and Jan-June figures, monthly data from statistics office Bundesamt fuer Wirtschaft (BAW) showed.
Castings figures were also mostly better than in Jan-July, with aluminium and lead castings ahead of last year and copper, zinc and tin showing smaller losses than previously.
Output of primary aluminium, copper and zinc in Jan/Aug 1996 was above year-ago levels, but their lead over the same 1995 period narrowed compared with Jan/July and Jan/June 1996 figures.
Lead output in Jan/August extended its losses over 1995.
The report gave the following details, in tonnes--
METALS OUTPUT Aug 96 Jan/Aug 96 pct change
SEMI-FINISHED METALS Aug 96 Jan/Aug 96 pct change
METALS CASTINGS Aug 96 Jan/Aug 96 pct change
Semis and castings figures include alloys. Nickel castings data were not given.
